text: DEFONEOS — DfE Department for Education — Schools, Academies & SEND Reform AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for DfE Department for Education Schools Academies SEND Reform. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DfE × Department for Education × Education × Academies × SEND × Teacher Workforce × Skills Department for Education — Schools, Academies & SEND Reform AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Department for Education — covering schools oversight, academy trust governance, SEND reform, teacher workforce strategy, curriculum assessment, funding formula, safeguarding, early years, technical education, EdTech, performance data, careers guidance, and parliamentary accountability across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Schools 1. Multi-Academy Trust Oversight MAT growth monitoring, financial health assessments, Regional Schools Commissioner intervention powers, academy transfer protocols, and trust board governance. Coasting schools identification, trust capacity frameworks, and accountability across 24,000+ schools and 1,200+ MATs. SEND 2. SEND & Alternative Provision Reform Education, Health & Care Plan (EHCP) process, SEND tribunal outcomes and trends, inclusion framework design, and alternative provision quality standards. The SEND Improvement Plan, post-16 SEND transitions, supported internships, and local area SEND inspections. Teachers 3. Teacher Workforce Strategy Teacher recruitment targets vs actuals, retention data and attrition modelling, Early Career Framework (ECF) rollout, National Professional Qualifications (NPQ), and Teachers' Pay Review Body recommendations. Workload reduction initiatives, flexible working, and subject-specific recruitment incentives. Curriculum 4. Curriculum & Assessment Reform National Curriculum review, GCSE and A-Level reform, KS2 SATs, phonics screening check, and multiplication tables check. Oak National Academy digital curriculum, English Baccalaureate targets, T-Level vocational pathways, and qualification reform programme. Funding 5. School Funding Formula National Funding Formula (NFF), Pupil Premium allocation, COVID catch-up premium, and high-needs block. Dedicated Schools Grant (DSG), minimum per-pupil funding guarantees, disadvantage weighting, and school-level financial benchmarking. Safeguarding 6. Safeguarding & Prevent Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSiE) statutory guidance, Designated Safeguarding Lead responsibilities, Prevent duty compliance, and online safety standards. Filtering and monitoring requirements, peer-on-peer abuse protocols, and allegations management against staff. Early Years 7. Early Years Foundation Stage EYFS statutory framework, Reception Baseline Assessment, childcare entitlement expansion, and maintained nursery school sustainability. 30-hour funded childcare, childminder agency support, early language development initiatives, and the Healthy Child Programme integration. Skills 8. Technical Education & Apprenticeships T-Level rollout and provider readiness, Institute for Apprenticeships & Technical Education (IfATE) occupational maps, Skills England mandate, and higher technical qualifications. Apprenticeship levy utilisation, employer engagement, and level 2-3 vocational pathways. EdTech 9. Digital Schools & EdTech Strategy DfE digital and technology standards for schools, broadband connectivity targets, device distribution programmes, and cloud-first schools policy. AI in education policy framework, assistive technology for SEND learners, and cyber security standards aligned with NCSC guidance. Data 10. School Performance & Data Ofsted inspection outcomes and trends, performance tables, Individual School Data Reports (IDSR), and FFT Aspire benchmarking.
